records.supported_name_scope: The complete generalized ring follows the north-south Waterhen Lake basin and its two short southern lobes. The southern tips end above the long connecting reach; the separately labelled Lake Winnipegosis water, Inland Lake and Chitek Lake are surrounding context. The coarse western edge omits bays and shoreline water, eastern margins overshoot onto geological land, and narrow southern margins cut both water and land. Exact connecting-water name transitions and the entire detailed named-lake extent remain unverified. This supports a bounded generalized research identity only; no product scalar name is approved.
